item.title: Israel looking for 'solutions' to open Christian sites after barring church leader on Palm Sunday due to war
item.summary: Jerusalem's Church of the Holy Sepulchre closed on Palm Sunday under Israeli wartime rules, drawing rebukes from the Catholic Church and Italy.

item.title: Jet fuel spikes as airlines warn supplies could run dry within weeks
item.summary: U.S. jet fuel prices jumped from $2.17 to $4.57 per gallon in weeks, prompting airline cuts and raising concerns over shortages and higher fares.

item.title: UFC fighter Alexa Grasso delivers vicious KO to Maycee Barber
item.summary: UFC flyweight fighter Alexa Grasso viciously knocked out Maycee Barber during their fight at UFC Seattle on Saturday night. She's emerged as a contender for the title

item.title: Kurt Russell reflects on humble upbringing, says he once lived in an attic in LA
item.summary: Kurt Russell recalls living in an attic in East LA as a child after his father left baseball to pursue acting, reflecting on his humble beginnings.

item.title: Tyrell Fortune wins UFC debut after score error reversal, years after being pronounced dead
item.summary: UFC heavyweight Tyrell Fortune accepted a fight on two weeks' notice and won by unanimous decision, only to leave the octagon after the cage announcer misread the scores.

item.title: Border czar Tom Homan rips Congress for paid vacation as TSA agents struggle without pay
item.summary: Border czar Tom Homan told CNN’s Jake Tapper that unpaid TSA agents were "struggling" to feed their families and pay rent, while Congress remained stuck in a funding fight.

item.title: FBI email hack shows why you must lock down your tech
item.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel's personal email was hacked, with Iran's Handala Hack Team claiming responsibility. No classified data was breached, the FBI says.

item.title: Scathing report claims nation's oldest labor union 'betrayed' MAGA members through 'shocking' spending
item.summary: A watchdog report alleges railroad union BLET spent 99% of party donations on Democrats, despite data suggesting its members largely back President Donald Trump.

item.title: Ex-Vikings star Joey Browner dead at 65
item.summary: Joey Browner, a former Minnesota Vikings and Tampa Bay Buccaneers defensive back, has died. He was 65. Browner earned six Pro Bowl selections in his career.

item.title: Daughter of Air Canada flight attendant ejected from crash provides update, details mother's injuries
item.summary: Air Canada flight attendant Solange Tremblay survived the LaGuardia runway crash with shattered legs and a fractured spine, her daughter says in a GoFundMe appeal.
